description.value: Hon's Coquitlam Branch is a Chinese comfort-food restaurant that has been serving authentic Asian dishes since 1972, located in the Sunwood Square shopping centre on Lougheed Highway. The menu centres on traditional noodles, dim sum, rice wraps, and their signature potstickers. Takeout and local delivery are core offerings, making it a practical meal stop for cyclists passing through the area.
